name: CO oxidation, five-step LH, PSU treatment in the axial bed
description: Nine free rate constants with step 4's reverse closed by detailed balance, in the one-dimensional dispersed bed -- the published PSU fit's own free-parameter set, units, and reactor.
derivation: reversible with thermodynamic closure on step 4, partial-pressure basis, axially-dispersed packed bed

reactor.notes: Per-kilogram rates on the partial-pressure basis, matching the reference implementation so fitted constants compare directly against its published nlparci intervals.

constraint.source: CODATA (Cox, Wagman et al. 1984) formation enthalpies + NIST Shomate S(T), H(T)-H(298.15) for CO, O2, CO2 [gas-thermo-codata-shomate-2026-08-25]
constraint.notes: The reverse constant is derived from the other nine plus the overall equilibrium constant. The adsorbate free energies cancel around the closure cycle, so the gas-phase tables anchor it and the fitted constants of the other reversible steps carry the adsorbate thermochemistry implicitly -- fitted, not looked up.
